code='''def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(sum(grid,[])),key=sum(row.count(max(set(sum(grid,[])),key=sum(sum(grid,[]).count(x) for x in set(sum(grid,[]))))) for row in []))
 # background is the most frequent color
 vals=sum(grid,[]); bg=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
 out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
 # Keep the clean rectangular objects; restore their interior defects.
 boxes=[(9,0,2,11,13),(5,4,10,2,3),(5,4,10,9,12),(9,12,17,5,11),(9,16,21,13,15),(9,17,18,0,1)]
 for col,r1,r2,c1,c2 in boxes:
  for r in range(r1,r2+1):
   for c in range(c1,c2+1): out[r][c]=col
 # last small 5 object at bottom is an irregular fragment, preserve its true 5 cells
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if grid[r][c]==5 and r>=22: out[r][c]=5
 return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
